F_CAND_G_1.statement: Trajectory variance (std/mean) >= 0.1 across 16 layers on neutral prompt
F_CAND_G_1.FAIL_TRUE: std/mean < 0.05 (all layers nearly identical — capture mechanism invalid OR substrate truly uniform)

F_CAND_G_2.statement: tension_peak_layer stable +/- 1 across 5 paraphrases of same axis-bucket prompt
F_CAND_G_2.PASS: peak stable (axis x prompt deterministic signal)
F_CAND_G_2.FAIL_FALSE: peak at layer 0 or 15 on >50% of prompts (boundary capture artifact — hook mis-attached)

F_CAND_G_3.statement: Pearson |r| between trajectory shape summary (peak_layer or variance) and phi_star >= 0.3 across 20-prompt eval
F_CAND_G_3.FAIL_TRUE: |r| < 0.1 (orthogonal channel — still useful but not joint signature)
F_CAND_G_3.FAIL_FALSE: trajectory NaN or phi_star measurement crash

F_CAND_H_1.statement: head_g_consistency >= 0.05 on neutral 64-token prompt (3000x random floor for vocab=64000)
F_CAND_H_1.FAIL_TRUE: consistency < 0.05 (head_g either never trained for retention or architecturally degraded; emerge candidate H closes negative)
F_CAND_H_1.FAIL_FALSE: logits_g shape mismatch with input_ids OR NaN/inf in logits_g OR forward crash

F_CAND_H_2.statement: divergence_pos density falls in [30%, 70%] of available positions
F_CAND_H_2.FAIL_TRUE: density < 0.05 (over-agreement — likely trivial-input collapse) OR > 0.95 (near-total disagreement — reduces to F-CAND-H-1)

F_CAND_H_3.statement: Pearson |r| between head_g_consistency and phi_star across 20-prompt eval >= 0.2
F_CAND_H_3.PASS: correlation surfaces (consistency x phi co-vary either direction)
F_CAND_H_3.FAIL_TRUE: |r| < 0.1 (bidirectional consistency orthogonal to phi_star — not falsified, just not joined)

F_CAND_GH_COMBINED.statement: On 100 axis-eval prompts, > 50% cluster in <= 4 of 12 fingerprint cells (concentration >= 0.5)
F_CAND_GH_COMBINED.FAIL_TRUE: concentration < 0.25 (uniform distribution — high-noise channel, research-only value)
F_CAND_GH_COMBINED.FAIL_FALSE: any of F-CAND-G/H upstream FAIL_FALSE propagates
